items.title: Solana Treasury Firm DeFi Dev Corp Rolls Out $300M CHAD to Buy More SOL
items.summary: DeFi Development Corp added another 55,491 SOL and opened a CHAD at-the-market program for its preferred stock, extending a fast-moving three-week run of capital markets activity.
